$description: Tokens for the redesign (direction D, variant A 'Slate' from the visual system prototype, #233). Staged beside designs/tokens.json, which still drives today's UI; the build swaps them in. Colors are hex or rgba; sizes are CSS px.

color.$description: Theme tokens. Light and dark follow the system. accent is the one brand color in the chrome; needs is used only for Needs you.

terminal.$description: The bridge's Terminal tab, on term in both themes.

status.$description: Ship status: the color token and the ring glyph in icons/. Glyphs carry the meaning; color only reinforces it.

fleet.$description: Fleet colors in assignment order, per theme. ink is the text color on that fill. Shown as the fleet dot and the ship's hull.

crew.$description: Crew member colors in assignment order, the fill of their square bot face. The face's eyes are #14304A.

harness.$description: The flag is a rounded tile (radius 5 at 18px) drawing the logo-<harness> symbol, centred with clear space, on the field the vendor's usage rules set (docs/research/harness-logos.md). The placeholder letters are used until a real logo is present.

shape.touchNote: Under (pointer: coarse) every row, nav item, button and tab is at least minTouchTarget tall. The engineer works from an iPad, so this density is the floor: variant A2 (34px rows) was tried and rejected as too compact.

icon.$description: Line icons: 24px viewBox, stroke currentColor, width 1.8 to 2, round caps and joins. Nav icons render at 15px.
icon.admiralBot: The Admiral mark, in colour, at 15 to 22px.
icon.ship: icons/ship.svg (line hull and sail, hull filled in the fleet color); icons/ship-moored.svg (the sail furled to a yard); Anchored draws ship.svg at 55% opacity.
icon.crewMember: icons/bot-crew.svg, filled with the crew color.
icon.subagent: icons/bot-subagent.svg, outline in muted, at about 70% of a crew member's size.

motion.$description: Quiet by default. All motion is off under prefers-reduced-motion.
motion.peekIn: 0.22s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1), slides in from the right edge
motion.inboxCardFold: 0.25s ease-out, a card becomes its one-line confirmation
